instance.basis: FICTIONAL. Plant OT monitoring at a named chemical processing site confirms unauthorized logic changes on the safety instrumented system controller, verified against the change-management record (not a maintenance change). Concurrent process alarms show an excursion developing while the last-resort trip is disabled. Every factor converges at the top of its scale; the type band is already critical, so the conditioned priority holds at critical — the escalate-only contract has no band above it. Urgency beyond the band is carried by case management, not by the score.
